تستقضون (form X)
# تَسْتَقْضُونَ (tastaqḍūna) /tas.taq.dˤuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
# تُسْتَقْضَوْنَ (tustaqḍawna) /tus.taq.dˤaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْضَى (istaqḍā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
